title: Zephyrine and the Machine
author: Casper Thackeray
blurb: Elodie Galloway, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
